title: Flow run request
description: Body of POST /api/flows/run on FormLogic Desktop (future desktop runner) AND the browser runner's internal run descriptor. Also the shape FormLogic records when creating a flow_run_logs row. Canonical copy: formlogic-app/docs/contracts/.

flowId.description: flow_definitions.slug. Either flowId or inline flowJson is required.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the flow needs (e.g. model.llm.local, formlogic.responses.read/write, connector.aokie.*). The runner refuses to start a flow requesting capabilities the caller's grants do not cover.
